Naruto Met His Parents Through Their Paperwork (It's Canon)
1,000 Naruto Clones Asked The Hokage One Question | Part 2
description:
Every chair in the Hokage's office is full of Narutos, and they have one question: who was Kushina Uzumaki? The Third finally tells the truth.

Part 2 of the full-cast Naruto What-If audio drama (AI voices). A thousand clones listen while the Third Hokage breaks his own twelve-year law, then Naruto asks for one thing: his parents' mission reports. At midnight in the archive he meets his father through dry, exact patrol reports and his mother through an incident file of everything she ever broke, finds a team report with eleven late dates in it, and trades a beginner's chakra primer to the fox in his seal for one true memory. A Root agent sits on a filing box, Danzo's requisition meets a staff form, and Team Seven runs out of D-rank missions. He still does not get stronger. He gets to read first.

SPOILER NOTE: this part tells the night of October 10th, names Naruto's parents and Team Minato, and explains why Kakashi is always late. If you have only watched the first arcs of the original anime you may not know these yet.
